feeds.name: DWD weather warnings
feeds.attribution: Deutscher Wetterdienst; Geobasisdaten © GeoBasis-DE / BKG 2021 (Daten modifiziert)

terms.note: The warnings are CC BY 4.0-equivalent under §5 of the terms. The area shapes come from the geocode and alias files MeteoAlarm publishes on its Redistribution Hub for redistributors to draw warning areas with; the files carry no licence of their own, and they are used as KDE's FOSS Public Alert Server uses them (credited "Meteoalarm / EUMETNET"). The terms require redistribution within ten minutes of MeteoAlarm's site: a warning expires three minutes after the poll that read it. A display shows the issuing service ("EUMETNET – MeteoAlarm" across countries), the issue time, a link to www.meteoalarm.org and the notice, and keeps the warning's text unaltered.
terms.notice: Time delays between this website and the www.meteoalarm.org website are possible. For the most up-to-date awareness information as published by the participating National Meteorological and Hydrological Services, please refer to www.meteoalarm.org.
